1: # JoinWitness
2: 
3: **执行关联前，看清哪些键会重复计数、丢失记录，以及反例在哪里。**
4: 
5: MoonBit 原创的有界等值关联预检库：精确输出规模、基数与覆盖率契约、可复现的三行反例、完整输入的缺失匹配核验，以及候选键的真实行对集合变化。
6: 
7: [在线工作台](https://jq-ai-nb.github.io/JoinWitness/) · [English](README.en.md) · [语义](docs/SEMANTICS.md) · [输入格式](docs/FORMAT.md) · [技术自检](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)

13: ## 为什么只比较行数不够
14: 
15: 订单和客户表都按 `customer` 关联，但不同租户可以拥有相同的 customer ID。示例中 4 笔订单关联后会变成 7 行，其中一个订单可以匹配到两位客户。JoinWitness 导出 **1 笔订单 + 2 位客户** 的完整三行反例：去掉其中任意一行，这个特定的基数违规就不再成立。
16: 
17: 候选复合键加入 `tenant` 后输出为 4 行，保留 4 个行对、去掉 3 个行对。是否确实符合业务含义仍由使用者判断。
18: 
19: 另一个示例中，更换关联键前后都输出 2 行，但 **保留 0、丢失 2、新增 2**。总数完全一样，实际关联对象已经全部换掉。仅做 count 回归会漏掉这个变化。
20: 
21: ## 已实现
22: 
23: - inner / left / right / full 等值关联；1..8 个可异名映射的组合键。
24: - 文本、整数、布尔值、NULL 严格区分；显式普通 SQL NULL 或组件式 null-safe 匹配。
25: - 通过键桶乘积计算精确匹配数量和外连接输出，提前判断预算，无需构造庞大的输出积。
26: - matched-group 基数契约、左右覆盖率、输出上限，互相独立检查。
27: - 违规来源行 ID、最小的三行多重匹配反例，以及针对完整对表核查的缺失匹配证据。
28: - 反例独立导出、再次检查，防止重复 ID、错误键与伪造范围被当作有效证据。
29: - 两套键的匹配行对交集与 lost/gained，既报告规模，也报告身份变化和新丢失覆盖。
30: - 全部契约通过后，按预算构造可追溯的完整来源行对；不输出失败事务的部分结果。
31: - 严格 JSON 协议、Node CLI、可运行 MoonBit 示例和交互式浏览器工作台。

33: ## 运行

36: 
37: ```sh
38: git clone https://github.com/JQ-ai-nb/JoinWitness.git
39: cd JoinWitness
40: moon check --target all --deny-warn
41: moon test --target all --deny-warn
42: moon build --target all --deny-warn
43: moon fmt --check
44: moon info
45: moon run cmd/demo
46: node scripts/build.mjs
47: node --test tests/cli.test.mjs
48: node scripts/serve.mjs
49: ```
50: 
51: 浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:4175`。Native 编译还需要平台 C 工具链；Windows CI 使用 MSVC。
52: 
53: ```sh
54: node bin/joinwitness.mjs check examples/tenant-collision.json
55: node bin/joinwitness.mjs case examples/tenant-collision.json 0
56: node bin/joinwitness.mjs materialize examples/tenant-collision.json --candidate
57: node scripts/benchmark.mjs
58: ```

60: 退出码 0：预检通过或成功导出；1：预检发现契约问题；2：无效输入、被拒绝的构造请求或 IO 错误。示例第一条 check **预期退出 1**，这是检测到问题。候选键只在显式 `--candidate` 时用于构造结果。
61:

66: ## 在 MoonBit 中调用
67: 
68: 模块命名空间为 `JQ-ai-nb/joinwitness`。Mooncakes 发布状态见 [RELEASE.md](docs/RELEASE.md)；确认发布前请使用源码。

71: 
72: ## 质量、规模与边界
73: 
74: 35 项 MoonBit 测试覆盖独立双重循环 oracle、组合键、NULL、基数、反例删除最小性、伪造证据、覆盖率、候选行对交集与资源限制。12 项 Node 集成测试验证真实 CLI/ESM；真实 SQLite 对照 320 组完整行对集合；Chromium 检查候选切换、反例下载、来源定位、注入文本和手机布局。CI 在 Linux/macOS/Windows 检查 wasm、wasm-gc、js、native。
75: 
76: Windows / i7-14650HX / Node 24 合成基准：两表各 10000 行的单键关联，精确预检 **1 亿**匹配对但不构造它们，中位约 **30.76ms**；两表各 5000 行的复合键比较中位约 **42.56ms**。包含解析、证据、比较和完整 JSON 输出，见 [基准范围](docs/BENCHMARK.md)。不将合成样例外推为生产吞吐承诺。
77: 
78: 这是有界内存工具，不解析任意 SQL、不连接数据库，也不验证真实业务键的语义。最多每表 10000 行、64 列、8 个关联键，文本单元长度 512、每表文本总量 2 Mi UTF-16 单元，JSON 输入 8 Mi 单元；最多构造 20000 个来源行对。证据返回上限 128 条，但问题总数完整统计。字符串精确、区分大小写；没有数据库排序规则、类型强转、范围关联或浮点近似匹配。
79: 
80: 三行反例仅用于构造式多重匹配违规；“没有匹配对象”必须结合完整对表核验，不能由一个空白小片段证明。证据复核不是加密来源认证，宿主负责可信输入、IO、持久化与隐私。

1: ///|
2: pub(all) struct Comparison {
3:   schema_version : Int32
4:   baseline : Audit
5:   candidate : Audit
6:   retained_pairs : Int64
7:   lost_pairs : Int64
8:   gained_pairs : Int64
9:   newly_unmatched_left : Array[String]
10:   newly_unmatched_right : Array[String]
11:   recovered_left : Array[String]
12:   recovered_right : Array[String]
13: } derive(ToJson)
14: 
15: ///|
16: fn list_minus(a : Array[String], b : Array[String]) -> Array[String] {
17:   let lookup : Map[String, Bool] = Map([])
18:   for id in b {
19:     lookup[id] = true
20:   }
21:   a.filter(id => !lookup.contains(id))
22: }
23: 
24: ///|
25: /// Exact pair-set changes. Reduced output does not prove a business-correct key.
26: pub fn compare(
27:   left : Table,
28:   right : Table,
29:   baseline : Plan,
30:   candidate : Plan,
31: ) -> Comparison raise JoinError {
32:   if baseline.kind != candidate.kind || baseline.nulls != candidate.nulls {
33:     invalid("comparison requires identical join kind and null semantics")
34:   }
35:   let before = audit(left, right, baseline)
36:   let after = audit(left, right, candidate)
37:   let li = indexes(left, baseline.keys, true)
38:   let ri = indexes(right, baseline.keys, false)
39:   for pos in indexes(left, candidate.keys, true) {
40:     li.push(pos)
41:   }
42:   for pos in indexes(right, candidate.keys, false) {
43:     ri.push(pos)
44:   }
45:   // Conjunction of both match predicates equals intersection of their pair sets.
46:   let retained = inventory_keys(left, right, li, ri, baseline.nulls, "inner").matched_pairs
47:   {
48:     schema_version: 1,
49:     baseline: before,
50:     candidate: after,
51:     retained_pairs: retained,
52:     lost_pairs: before.inventory.matched_pairs - retained,
53:     gained_pairs: after.inventory.matched_pairs - retained,
54:     newly_unmatched_left: list_minus(
55:       after.inventory.unmatched_left,
56:       before.inventory.unmatched_left,
57:     ),
58:     newly_unmatched_right: list_minus(
59:       after.inventory.unmatched_right,
60:       before.inventory.unmatched_right,
61:     ),
62:     recovered_left: list_minus(
63:       before.inventory.unmatched_left,
64:       after.inventory.unmatched_left,
65:     ),
66:     recovered_right: list_minus(
67:       before.inventory.unmatched_right,
68:       after.inventory.unmatched_right,
69:     ),
70:   }
71: }

1: # TideWeave
2: 
3: **让迟到与撤回的数据得到完整、一致、可解释的修正。**
4: 
5: MoonBit 事件时间窗口与修正日志引擎。迟到事件可以合并会话，撤回桥接事件可以重新拆分会话；每次原子修正输出 before/after 变更，显式水位线保护已终结事实，下游按版本检查漏接与旧值冲突。
6: 
7: [在线实验室](https://lmk-ai-nb.github.io/TideWeave/) · [Mooncakes](https://mooncakes.io/docs/LMK-ai-nb/tideweave) · [English](README.en.md) · [语义契约](docs/SEMANTICS.md) · [自检证据](docs/ACCEPTANCE.md)
8: 
9: ![跨平台 CI](https://github.com/LMK-ai-nb/TideWeave/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)
10: 
11: ![实验室中的迟到事件合并与变更日志](docs/assets/laboratory.png)
12: 
13: ## 一个容易出错的真实问题
14: 
15: 同一设备先上报 at=0 和 at=16 的两条记录，gap=10，因此它们属于两个会话。设备恢复网络后补传 at=8 的记录，两个会话应合并。随后发现该记录有误并撤回，窗口必须再次拆分。只对 SUM 做加减会留下错误的边界、成员与 min/max。
16: 
17: TideWeave 将每次修正视为原子状态变更：计算候选事实 → 重建受影响 key → 校验终结约束 → 提交版本 → 输出完整变更。事务若失败，窗口、事件索引、去重状态与版本一起保持原状。
18: 
19: ## 已实现
20: 
21: - 滚动、带相位偏移的滑动与会话窗口；半开区间；负窗口起点的数学 floor 对齐。
22: - 按事件 ID 插入、替换、撤回，支持跨 key 移动与多项原子事务。
23: - 会话迟到合并、撤回拆分，count / Int64 sum / min / max 与完整成员来源。
24: - open → closing → final；保护已终结窗口及原始事件，拒绝将旧事实重新打开。
25: - 成功命令幂等、冲突检测；可重放检查点恢复后继续去重。
26: - 稳定顺序的 before/after 日志，以及校验版本连续性、旧值与原子应用的下游 `View`。
27: - 严格 JSON 协议，拒绝重复解码键、未知字段、被浮点舍入掩盖的小数和不适用参数。
28: - Node CLI、三个可重现用例、交互式浏览器实验室，共用 MoonBit 核心。
29: 
30: ## 在 MoonBit 中使用
31: 
32: 要求编译器 **0.10.16 或更新兼容版本**。
33: 
34: ```sh
35: moon add LMK-ai-nb/tideweave@0.1.0
36: ```
37: 
38: 在消费项目的 `moon.pkg` 加入：
39: 
40: ```moonbit
41: import { "LMK-ai-nb/tideweave" @tide }
42: ```
43: 
44: 在可抛出错误的函数中：
45: 
46: ```moonbit
47: let cfg = @tide.config(@tide.Session(gap=10), lateness=20)
48: let engine = @tide.Engine::new(cfg)
49: let view = @tide.View::new()
50: let outcome = engine.apply(@tide.Transact(id="batch-1", changes=[
51:   @tide.Put({ id: "left", key: "device-A", at: 0, value: 20 }),
52:   @tide.Put({ id: "right", key: "device-A", at: 16, value: 35 }),
53: ]))
54: view.apply(outcome)
55: let restored = @tide.restore(engine.checkpoint())
56: assert_true(restored.rows() == engine.rows())
57: ```
58: 
59: 完整公开接口由 `moon info` 生成，见 [pkg.generated.mbti](pkg.generated.mbti)。`aggregate` 可批处理；`Engine` 可持续接收容量内的修正；`replay_json` / `resume_json` 提供严格文本边界。
60: 
61: ## 运行与验证
62:

64: moon version --all
65: moon check --target all --deny-warn
66: moon test --target all --deny-warn
67: moon build --target all --deny-warn

77:

84: CLI 退出码：0 表示所有命令 accepted/duplicate；1 表示存在 rejected/conflict（演示中有意触发）；2 表示输入／IO／运行错误。恢复时传入 `{schema_version:1,checkpoint:<保存的对象>,commands:[...]}` 并使用 `resume` 子命令。完整格式见 [FORMAT.md](docs/FORMAT.md)。

1: # colmugx/json-schema
2: 
3: A compile-once JSON Schema validator for MoonBit, built around **precise
4: 2020-12 validation scenarios** rather than permissive approximations.
5: 
6: **Status: development milestone, not a complete 2020-12 implementation.**
7: Static and dynamic references, resource identifiers and anchors, and
8: `unevaluatedProperties`/`unevaluatedItems` are supported. Cross-resource references
9: use an explicit preloaded registry: the compiler and validator never fetch URIs.
10: Custom dialects and vocabulary negotiation remain outside the supported profile.
11: 
12: ## Use it for
13: 
14: - Closed tool/request argument objects (`additionalProperties: false`).
15: - Structured result validation, tuples, array membership and dependencies.
16: - Exact decimal `multipleOf`, integer checks and numeric bounds.
17: - Unicode code-point string lengths and an explicitly supported pattern profile.
18: - Reusing one owned compiled schema for many instances.
19: 
20: The module is maintained as an independent repository and has no dependency on
21: MCP. Run the commands below from this module's root, including when it is checked
22: out as a workspace member. Runners use `moon run` instead of assuming a fixed
23: binary output path inside an enclosing workspace.
24: 
25: ## Quick start
26: 
27: Import `"colmugx/json-schema"` in your package. Parse numbers through this
28: library when their original decimal values matter:
29:

103: ### Preserve number precision
104: 
105: A floating-point value cannot recover digits lost before validation. This
106: library's parser keeps number lexemes in `Json::Number`'s `repr` field; numeric
107: predicates use integer coefficients and decimal scales, not an epsilon or a
108: rounded decimal quotient. Core-parsed or programmatically constructed numbers
109: without a lexeme use the available finite `Double` representation instead.
110: 
111: Parsing and arithmetic support are separate: the parser retains valid JSON
112: number literals even when their exponent exceeds the evaluator's supported
113: range. Exact arithmetic currently bounds the exponent and decimal scale to
114: ±100000; schema compilation or evaluation outside that range raises a typed
115: error rather than rounding a value or returning an ordinary validation failure.
116: This lets protocol callers safely round-trip such literals without claiming
117: that the validator can execute constraints over every possible decimal scale.

1: # error-report
2: 
3: Source-annotated diagnostic reports for MoonBit, in the lineage of Rust's
4: [miette](https://docs.rs/miette), [codespan-reporting](https://docs.rs/codespan-reporting)
5: and [ariadne](https://docs.rs/ariadne).
6: 
7: **Data first, renderers second.** A `Report` is a plain value: severity, a stable
8: code, a message, labelled spans, notes, a help line, and machine-applicable
9: fixes. A consumer that wants to build its own presentation reads the fields and
10: never calls a renderer. A consumer that just wants something good to print in a
11: terminal calls `render` and is done.
12: 
13: ## Installing
14: 
15: ```sh
16: moon add marianoguerra/error-report
17: ```
18: 
19: The module name contains a dash, so it cannot be referenced under its default
20: alias. Give it one in the `moon.pkg` of each package that uses it:
21: 
22: ```
23: import {
24:   "marianoguerra/error-report" @report,
25:   "marianoguerra/error-report/render",
26: }
27: ```
28: 
29: ## A report
30: 
31: ```mbt check
32: ///|
33: test {
34:   let sources = @report.Sources::new()
35:   let id = sources.add("greeting.txt", "hello:\n  world\n universe\n")
36:   let r = @report.Report::error("wrong indentation")
37:     .with_code("demo::wrong_indentation")
38:     .with_label(
39:       @report.Label::primary(
40:         id,
41:         @report.Span::of_range(9, 14),
42:         message="this group starts here",
43:       ),
44:     )
45:     .with_label(
46:       @report.Label::secondary(
47:         id,
48:         @report.Span::of_range(16, 24),
49:         message="but this one is less indented",
50:       ),
51:     )
52:     .with_help("indent every group in a block to the same column")
53:   let config = {
54:     ..@render.default_config,
55:     theme: @style.mono_theme,
56:     color: Never,
57:   }
58:   inspect(
59:     @render.render_string(r, sources, config),
60:     content=(
61:       #|error[demo::wrong_indentation]: wrong indentation
62:       #|  ╭─[ greeting.txt:2:3 ]
63:       #|  │
64:       #|1 │ hello:
65:       #|2 │   world

122: `Format::Short` is one line per report, in the shape editors and `grep` already
123: understand. `Format::Json` is one JSON object per line. `Format::Compact` is the
124: headed message with no source snippet, for when the source is not to hand or a
125: hundred reports are being listed.
126: 
127: ```mbt check
128: ///|
129: test {
130:   let sources = @report.Sources::new()
131:   let id = sources.add("greeting.txt", "hello:\n  world\n universe\n")
132:   let r = @report.Report::error("wrong indentation")
133:     .with_code("demo::wrong_indentation")
134:     .with_label(@report.Label::primary(id, @report.Span::of_range(16, 24)))
135:   let config = {
136:     ..@render.default_config,
137:     theme: @style.mono_theme,
138:     color: Never,
139:     format: Short,
140:   }
141:   inspect(
142:     @render.render_string(r, sources, config),
143:     content=(
144:       #|greeting.txt:3:2: error[demo::wrong_indentation]: wrong indentation
145:       #|
146:     ),
147:   )
148: }
149: ```
150: 
151: ## Units
152: 
153: Every offset in this library is a **UTF-16 code unit** offset into the source
154: `String` — the unit `String::length`, `String::at` and `String::get_view` use, so
155: slicing carries no hidden conversion.
156: 
157: That will surprise anyone coming from a library in a language whose strings are
158: bytes. A producer counting something else converts once, at the boundary:
159: `Source::span_of_chars` takes code-point offsets, which is what Racket's
160: `port-next-location` and most hand-written lexers report. Converting at the
161: boundary is cheap; converting inside the renderer, on every label of every
162: report, is not.
163: 
164: Rendered **columns** are a third thing again: display columns, with tabs
165: expanded and East Asian Wide characters counted as two, so that a caret lands
